Translated from the official Greek paper (35ος Πανελλήνιος Διαγωνισμός Φυσικής Λυκείου «Δημόκριτος», Γ΄ Λυκείου, 15 March 2025). No marks are printed in the paper. Translated from the official Greek paper (35ος Πανελλήνιος Διαγωνισμός Φυσικής Λυκείου «Δημόκριτος», Γ΄ Λυκείου, 15 March 2025). No marks are printed in the paper. Decimal commas, units and symbols are kept as printed. Printed as in the source: 'μάζα 3m' in upright type. Part (A) literally asks for the relation between the forces N1, N2 «που ασκούνται από τα υποστηρίγματα στα Σ1 και Σ2» (exerted by the supports on Σ1 and Σ2); translated literally.

greece.2025.1.3.source_format: Official ΕΕΦ examination paper (Greek), translated into English for this bank; the translation was checked against the page images of the original
greece.2025.1.3.source_variant_note: Problems © Ένωση Ελλήνων Φυσικών (ΕΕΦ). Translated from the official Greek paper (35ος Πανελλήνιος Διαγωνισμός Φυσικής Λυκείου «Δημόκριτος», Γ΄ Λυκείου, 15 March 2025). No marks are printed in the paper. Decimal commas, units and symbols are kept as printed. «πλαστικά» (plastic collision) is translated 'inelastically (they stick together)'; ΑΑΤ = simple harmonic motion. In question 4, Δk/Δt is printed with k (the kinetic energy; the same letter as the spring constant). «Οι αντιστάσεις θεωρούνται αμελητέες» is translated literally ('Resistances are considered negligible', i.e. air resistance). Units in the given data printed as 'm=1kg', 'k=100 N/m', '\ell_o=1m'.
